name: es31-stencil-texturing-and-level-queries
title: Stencil texturing and texture level queries
summary: DEPTH24_STENCIL8 and DEPTH32F_STENCIL8 textures are filled through a framebuffer with only a depth/stencil attachment (three passes of rectangles whose stencil values come from REPLACE, INCR, ZERO and INVERT under a write mask) and then read back in the shader: depth through a sampler2D (DEPTH_STENCIL_TEXTURE_MODE = DEPTH_COMPONENT), stencil through a usampler2D (STENCIL_INDEX), every one of the 1024 texels compared with a CPU model (a compute shader dumps texelFetch and textureLod results into an SSBO; a contact sheet shows the same through fragment shaders). glGetTexLevelParameteriv/fv is compared with what was allocated for 25 internal formats, every level of 2D, 3D, 2D-array and cube-map (six faces) textures, mutable and immutable images, ETC2 and multisample textures, plus its errors.
spec: ES 3.2 §8.16 Combined Depth/Stencil Textures (DEPTH_STENCIL_TEXTURE_MODE: depth by default, STENCIL_INDEX returns an unsigned integer, only NEAREST filtering, ignored for non depth/stencil textures)
ES 3.2 §8.11.3 Texture Level Parameter Queries (target and level rules, component types and actual resolutions, compressed images, INVALID_ENUM / INVALID_VALUE), §8.11.2 Texture Parameter Queries

ES 3.2 §8.10 Texture Parameters (table 8.19, errors), §8.19 Texture State (initial DEPTH_STENCIL_TEXTURE_MODE), §8.20 Texture Comparison Modes (r = St), §11.1.3.5 Texture Access (unsigned integer sampler for the stencil index)

ES 3.2 §8.5 Texture Image Specification (tables 8.10 and 8.11: minimum component resolutions), §8.8 Multisample Textures, §8.17 Texture Completeness (NEAREST for depth and stencil sampling), §8.18 Immutable-Format Texture Images
ES 3.2 §9.4.2 Whole Framebuffer Completeness (depth and stencil attachments are the same image; SAMPLES of a framebuffer with a multisample texture), §9.2.3.1 Multisample Queries
ES 3.2 §15.1.2 Stencil Test, §15.1.3 Depth Buffer Test, §12.6.1 Controlling the Viewport (fixed-point window depth), §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization (BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT)
GLSL ES 3.10 §8.9 Texture Functions (texelFetch, textureLod, texture on usampler2D), §7.1.3 Compute Shader Special Variables

api.glTexParameteri: DEPTH_STENCIL_TEXTURE_MODE = DEPTH_COMPONENT / STENCIL_INDEX switches what a shader reads from the same texture (1024 depth values through a sampler2D, 1024 stencil values through a usampler2D, exactly as the CPU model says, for DEPTH24_STENCIL8 and DEPTH32F_STENCIL8; switching back restores the depth view); the mode is ignored for an RGBA8 texture and a DEPTH_COMPONENT32F texture (still sampled as before); the value RED is rejected with INVALID_ENUM and leaves the mode unchanged; NEAREST min/mag filters make depth/stencil sampling complete
api.glGetTexParameteriv: DEPTH_STENCIL_TEXTURE_MODE is DEPTH_COMPONENT in a new texture, STENCIL_INDEX after being set, unchanged after the rejected value; TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT is TRUE after glTexStorage2D
api.glGetTexLevelParameteriv: WIDTH, HEIGHT, DEPTH, INTERNAL_FORMAT, RED/GREEN/BLUE/ALPHA/DEPTH/STENCIL/SHARED_SIZE, RED/GREEN/BLUE/ALPHA/DEPTH_TYPE and COMPRESSED for 25 sized formats, every level of a 3-level 2D, a 3-level 3D (depth halves), a 4-level 2D-array (layer count constant) and the six faces x 4 levels of a cube map, mutable glTexImage2D/3D images (respecified, unspecified level reports 0), COMPRESSED_RGB8_ETC2 (COMPRESSED = TRUE) and multisample textures (RGBA8 fixed locations, DEPTH24_STENCIL8 non-fixed: TEXTURE_SAMPLES between the request and the next larger supported count, TEXTURE_FIXED_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS as requested; TEXTURE_SAMPLES 0 and FIXED_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS TRUE for every non-multisample image); component sizes only need to reach the minimum of the format tables, absent components are identified by type NONE; INVALID_VALUE for level -1 and log2(MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE) + 1 (the boundary level is valid), for level 1 of a multisample texture; INVALID_ENUM for TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP
api.glGetTexLevelParameterfv: the same 19 pnames (including TEXTURE_SAMPLES and TEXTURE_FIXED_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS) as the integer query on every texture above: the float value equals the integer value
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable DEPTH24_STENCIL8 / DEPTH32F_STENCIL8 render and sampling targets, 25 formats of the level sweep, 2D levels, cube map and the ETC2 texture: the level queries report what was allocated
api.glTexStorage3D: 3D 8 x 4 x 6 and 2D-array 8 x 8 x 5 textures: width, height and depth of every level
api.glTexStorage2DMultisample: RGBA8 (16 x 8) and DEPTH24_STENCIL8 (8 x 8) multisample textures: level 0 reports the allocated size, format, resolutions, TEXTURE_SAMPLES and TEXTURE_FIXED_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS; the RGBA8 one attached to a framebuffer gives SAMPLE_BUFFERS = 1 and SAMPLES equal to its TEXTURE_SAMPLES
api.glTexImage2D: mutable levels (RGBA8 16 x 16 and 8 x 8, then respecified as RG8 4 x 2): the level queries follow the latest specification
api.glTexImage3D: mutable 3D image respecified from 4 x 4 x 4 to 2 x 2 x 8: depth follows
api.glTexSubImage2D: RGBA8 fixture data sampled in the shader with the stencil mode set (colors unchanged)
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT of a D24S8 / D32FS8 texture as the only attachment (complete, scene rendered into it), DEPTH_ATTACHMENT of a depth texture, COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 of a multisample texture
api.glDrawBuffers: NONE for the framebuffer that has only depth/stencil attachments: complete, rendering works
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE for the depth/stencil-only framebuffers and the multisample texture framebuffer
api.glClear: DEPTH and STENCIL of the textures: the cleared control texture reads depth 1 and stencil 0 and fails the model comparison
api.glClearDepthf: 1.0 for the scene, 0.5 for the depth fixture (read back as 0.5)
api.glClearStencil: 0 before the scene (texels outside every rectangle read 0)
api.glDepthFunc: LESS (and ALWAYS for pass 2b) decide which texels change in the three passes (the model reproduces all 1024 depth values)
api.glStencilFunc: ALWAYS ref v (pass 1), ALWAYS (2a), LESS 100 (2b): the model reproduces all 1024 stencil values
api.glStencilMask: 0xFF and 0xF0: with 0xF0 only the upper nibble of the stored value changes (model-exact)
api.glDepthMask: TRUE while the scene is drawn and the depth fixture cleared
api.glEnable: DEPTH_TEST and STENCIL_TEST during the scene passes
api.glDisable: the tests restored; DITHER off for the contact sheet
api.glUseProgram: scene, depth/stencil display and compute dump programs
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_rect, u_size, u_depth located; their effect is the rendered scene
api.glUniform1f: u_size and u_depth: rectangles land on the intended texels at the intended depth
api.glUniform4f: u_rect: rectangle placement verified texel by texel
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP rectangles (scene) and viewport quads (contact sheet)
api.glViewport: target-sized viewport for the scene, panels of the contact sheet
api.glBindTexture: textures bound for sampling, parameter state and level queries
api.glBindFramebuffer: scene rendering and the multisample query
api.glDispatchCompute: 4 x 4 work groups of 8 x 8 invocations over the 32 x 32 texture (and one group over the 4 x 4 fixtures): every texel is dumped (no sentinel word survives) and compared
api.glMemoryBarrier: BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT before mapping the dump buffer
api.glBufferData: dump buffer initialised with a sentinel pattern
api.glMapBufferRange: the dump is read through a read mapping
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the contact sheet (four 32 x 32 panels compared texel by texel)
api.glGetInternalformativ: NUM_SAMPLE_COUNTS and SAMPLES of RGBA8 and DEPTH24_STENCIL8 for TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE give the next larger supported count that bounds TEXTURE_SAMPLES from above

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture: 2 x 2 panels of 32 x 32 texels magnified 4x. Left column the depth component as grays (a 4 x 4 grid of 8 x 8 blocks of different gray, the lower-left block white = cleared depth 1, the middle flattened to one gray by the large rectangle, a darker small patch inside it), right column the stencil index as saturated colors (each block its own color; the middle recolored by the INCR pass and the masked INVERT/ZERO pass). The two rows (DEPTH32F_STENCIL8 on top, DEPTH24_STENCIL8 below) are pixel-identical.
